gaps: VLAT item numbering: the 53 VLAT images use the original VLAT test-bank item numbers (1..61 with gaps at 13, 24, 33, 34, 39, 46, 54, 58). These do NOT equal the data_processed.csv gcbID values (item_14..item_73) or origStudy_order_num (q_01..q_59). The item<->image mapping is positional: VLAT trials ordered by origStudy_order_num map one-to-one, in order, onto the VLAT images sorted ascending by number. This was verified by inspecting several images against their prompts (e.g. the first VLAT trial 'price of a barrel of oil in February 2015' <-> exp1_vlat_item1.png, a 'Monthly Oil Price History in 2015' line chart).

Procedure/results figures are intentionally excluded from stimuli/: the repo's schematic test-overview asset (assets/stimuli_task_procedure.png / paper Fig. 1) and the paper's results figures are a procedure schematic and results plots respectively, not participant-facing stimuli.
